name: University of Waterloo
summary: Waterloo was founded in 1957 in Ontario. Co-op students pay no tuition during work terms. Computer Science admits by individual selection, with admission averages in the low-to-mid 90s, and requires the Admission Information Form.

applicationPlatform.value: OUAC (Ontario Universities' Application Centre), plus Waterloo's Admission Information Form for Computer Science

internationalTuition.notes: Computer Science, international: estimated tuition and incidental fees of about C$73,000 for two study terms (first year). No tuition is charged on co-op work terms.
